page.layout: One printed page, title page. Centred below the middle: a small printed vignette (engraving) with vertical lines of tiny text on its left and right sides, then the imprint in three lines below it. A library stamp sits over the engraving and is left out. Show-through from the reverse side appears upside down across the upper half and in the centre, and is left out.
page.notes: The upper half and the centre carry upside-down, mirrored show-through from the reverse side. It is not transcribed. The small vertical text beside the engraving is too faint and too small to read, so it is not transcribed. The printer's name in the imprint line is uncertain and is marked [?]. The library stamp ("Ex Bibliotheca Genevensi") and the manuscript pencil notes at the left are not transcribed. The engraving is a plain architectural vignette.
